Chapter 6602: Lord Of All Things

Chapter 6602: Lord of All Things

A particular flowing river attracted everyone’s attention. Some noted that it was actually a maelstrom flowing at an unimaginable speed, crossing through countless years in the blink of an eye. This insane speed made it appear motionless in the air.

Primal ancestors and heaven-slayers noticed a rhythm to its rotation. At its center was a spring with water gushing out and collecting into a pond. However, they saw different things.

A few saw a golden liquid gushing out like nectar. Another saw a diamond liquid like the tears of the high heaven. Others perceived it as a spring of the supreme dao...

At first, they thought they saw the same thing. Once they exchanged information, they realized their perception of the spring was unique. Moreover, this wasn’t an illusion. What they saw correlated with their cultivation and willpower.

“I wonder what it is.” A primal ancestor was puzzled.

“A great fortune, for certain.” This became the consensus for these brilliant cultivators.

“This is more than just World Seal opening.” Light God was alarmed and gazed at the spring.

“Yes.” Li Qiye nodded.

“Senior Li Xingchen?” He noticed something while gazing at the galaxy above.

“Close enough.” Li Qiye said, focusing on the spring.

Some top primal ancestors and heaven-slayers had a good idea. Supreme overlords possessed more information.

“Li Xingchen’s rotation.” One overlord murmured.

Many conversations took place concurrently all over Three Immortals.

“I heard Li Xingchen disappeared after Nightwatch. Still alive, I see.” An emperor commented.

“Perhaps a type of rebirth.” A heaven-slayer recalled a star flying out of Primordial Portal: “And an attempt to inherit First Vine’s World Seal too.”

“World Seal is the number one artifact, right? First Vine smashed it against Dingtian, the finishing blow.” A desolate god said.

“I don’t think so, it should be inferior to Calamitous Edge.” An emperor responded.

“A rebirth and World Seal, Li Xingchen might become stronger than Xian Chengtian if he were alive.” A primal ancestor said.

“Don’t worry about other matters, only the fortune there.” A heaven-slayer said.

***

Only Li Qiye understood what was going on.

“What is Senior Li Xingchen’s goal? Rebirth?” Light God asked.

Supreme overlords wielded incredible power. Just one alone could devour Three Immortals immediately. They were the biggest threats in the absence of immortals. All would become food if they couldn’t restrain themselves.

“Not a rebirth or reincarnation, just a metamorphosis.” Li Qiye said.

“Into what?” Light God said: “This process is spilling the water of creation.”

“Yes, using Myriad Star Water as a beginning to become the Lord of All Things.” Li Qiye nodded.

“Lord of All Things. Comparable to Lord of Life and Death?” He blurted: “Wait, no, the latter is so close to becoming an immortal.”

He recalled Xian Chengtian’s mantra and knew it was accurate.

“Pop.” A massive fissure appeared in the starry sky as if a colossal eye had opened. However, there was no eye at all.

“World Seal’s dao.” Li Qiye said: “Calling it a heavenly dao is fine.”

“A weapon possesses such a supreme dao?” He murmured.

“Why not?” Li Qiye smiled: “It is sentient but due to First Vine’s passing, it became dormant. Now, Li Xingchen’s power of life and fortune can nourish it sufficiently.”

“Li Xingchen is turning into a lord and fusing with World Seal. Is that enough to become an immortal?” He said emotionally.

Li Qiye only smiled in response.

***

The crack shocked everyone in Heaven World. Worldly energy pulsed in and out, permeating across their world. They saw wondrous images within, teeming with life and vitality.

“Wait, that’s Three Immortals! It’s identical!” A primal ancestor saw his world among the images.

Sure enough, everyone took a closer look at the energy spewing out of the crack. It was conjuring another Three Immortals World.
